notes.title: Wishlist Drizzlepath: Picturae
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It has been almost ten years since my first game, Drizzlepath was released. And now my 25th game, [b]Drizzlepath: Picturae[/b] has a Steam store page live!

Back to the roots, I made an almost pure walking simulator, once again.

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33016994/2defb178febd794149a3158575e9616e70388fd0.jpg[/img]

In Drizzlepath: Picturae, you will [i]wander between paintings[/i] which have a completely different theme each. A little bit of tranquil, a little bit of thrill... The game uses Unreal Engine 5's Lumen technology to enhance the immersion.

It will be released on [b]November 7th[/b] so please add it to your wishlists now!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3273990/Drizzlepath_Picturae/

See you in the paintings ːdpeagleiaː

notes.title: Pluviophile Store Page is Live!
notes.notes:
Shout out to all the rain lovers out there!

My next game Pluviophile is back to the roots as it is a pure walking simulator that is all about slowly walking in the rainy woods, very similar to my earliest Drizzlepath games. It is a short and calming experience with beautiful visuals and atmosphere.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33016994/46f3c704988bdbb606266e973eadad570381a55d.jpg[/img]

So you hike around the nature away from civilization, reveal the passages of a beautiful poem from Julius Cawein as you progress. The experience also makes you listen to the original music score composed by talented Pınar Karabaş. The soundtrack will be on the Steam store as well, so you can download and listen even while you're not in game.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33016994/8b379127930b79ca2cc8b61044ec58df8175f9e8.jpg[/img]

The experience should take up to half an our or so, and will be priced accordingly. Just please make sure your system matches the minimum system requirements shown on the store page so it runs as expected.

If you like a rain shower, spread the word and wishlist it now from the link below!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1322170/Pluviophile/

PS: It's raining out of my window right now. Hype! ːdpglskittenː

notes.title: One handed controls enabled for the disabled
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, I've made some additions on the game's controls so the players with single hand (left or right) will be able to play it.

The newly added controls are;

[list]
[*] Right mouse button for moving forward
[*] Left mouse button for toggling run
[/list]

[list]
[*] Gamepad right & left triggers for moving forward
[*] Gamepad right & left bumpers for toggling run
[/list]

[list]
[*] And for the ones who can use the gamepad with their left hands only, there is a new option in General Settings menu named "One Handed Controls". It is set Off by default but if you set it On, then the gamepad's left thumbstick will act the same as the right one, and it will be used for the face look rotation. Combined with it you can move forward by the trigger and toggle tun by the bumper.
[/list]

Hopefully more of us will be able to experience Drizzlepath: Deja Vu.

Tonguc

notes.title: Full Controller Support Live
notes.notes:
Hey everyone,
I just rolled the version with the full controller support out. Now the menus are only in English language, but the subtitles are localized like before. You will now be able to run the game via Steam Big Picture mode for example on your Steam Link device, use every function of all the menus, fully run the game and quit when you want to. By just using your gamepad.
I'm planning to add this same menu system on some of my other games in the near future as well. And hopefully more of my games will fully support controllers ^^
If you encounter any issues about the new system, or about the games, please post them in the discussions page so I try to fix.
Have a lovely day, and game on! :btlthumbup:

notes.title: Full Controller Support Soon
